neighbours.label: picking one item out of a set of candidates or locating something at a site: 'one of the suspects', 'out of a lineup', 'on the site of'
fire: The victim managed to point out the attacker from a row of six men.
Doctors suspect the infection came from one of the three hospital wards.
Archaeologists think the temple stood on the site of a Roman fort.
Investigators narrowed the cause down to one of two faulty valves.
The jury had to decide which of the four defendants fired the shot.
Health officials listed raw oysters as one of the likely sources of the illness.
The new museum was built on the site of the old railway station.
Of all the possible culprits, the cat seemed the most likely to have broken the vase.
quiet: The victim managed to describe the attacker to the officers at the scene.
Doctors treated the infection with a strong course of antibiotics.
Archaeologists dated the temple to the second century using coins.
Investigators spent the week repairing the old pipes in the basement.
The jury listened quietly while the defendant gave his testimony.
Health officials warned people to cook their seafood thoroughly this summer.
The new museum opened its doors to the public last spring.
The cat knocked the vase off the shelf while chasing a fly.

notes: Logit effect promotes guess/candidate/plausible. Probes: 'out of a lineup of ten men' 0.97 (on ' of'), 'site of the modern village' 0.68, 'one of the five suspects' 0.70, 'one of the suspects' 0.24, 'points to' 0.12.
